summary: Completed BOTH backend and frontend testing for enterprise/resources expansion and M18 checks. Backend regression file added and passed (18/18). Frontend verified audience gateway/redirect persistence, enterprise workflows + pricing clamps, resources concept behavior, login return flow, admin enterprise/resources tabs, setup SQL download action, temporary pricing persistence + invalid slab validation + restore, and responsive overflow checks.

integration_issues.flow: Admin enterprise pricing invalid slab save
integration_issues.issue: UI error message is generic ('Please check the form and try again.') instead of surfacing backend validation detail ('Slabs must increase and end at 1000 seats').

action_items: Improve admin pricing validation UX by mapping backend 422 detail to a specific message in enterprise admin error state.
(Optional) add explicit data-testid route-level markers on Courses/CourseDetails to make /course/:id gateway automation deterministic without URL guessing.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend SQL 0048 is additive and correctly applies RLS+revoke/grants (anon/authenticated blocked; service_role only) for enterprise_leads, marketplace_resources, resource_orders.
Public catalog fields intentionally exclude file_path (no storage path leak in /resources catalog/detail responses).
Payment reconcile logic correctly enforces order_id/amount/currency/refund/captured checks before marking paid in resource_orders.
Enterprise/resources flows are intentionally blocked by missing schema setup; frontend concept previews and mailto fallback are correctly truthful.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified with public URL from frontend/.env. Captured required screenshots at 1920x800 and 390x844. Audience gateway works on /, /courses, and /course/equity-research-analyst first-visit; enterprise preference redirects /courses -> /enterprise/programme and persists; switching back to student restores /courses route. Enterprise page checks passed: workflow tabs, scene pause/reset, built-vs-training copy, seat slabs (1,10,11,50,51,200,201,1000), number clamps (0->1, >1000->1000), enquiry disabled + mailto fallback. Resources checks passed: search/category/empty state, concept detail notice, no fake purchase button for samples, unauth my-downloads redirects to /login and returns to /resources/library after login. Admin checks with info@valuevade.com passed: Enterprise/Resources tabs, setup status + download button action, temporary pricing edit persisted then invalid slab validation triggered and pricing restored to original values, resources Add disabled pending DB setup. Responsive overflow measurements: enterprise/resources showed overflow count 0 at widths 320,768,1024,1440.
rca of the issue: No functional backend regressions found. Only observed UX-level issue: admin invalid slab backend validation is collapsed to a generic frontend error string by businessApi() fallback behavior. Real resource checkout/download E2E remains blocked by known setup limitation (0048 tables/bucket absent), and was not force-tested with real payment as requested.
